newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges lower in higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges lower in higher volume.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed slightly lower on Wednesday but the volume of trade was higher, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 548.90, barely below Tuesday's 549.43 close.
Volume was 2.52 million dinars against 1.27 million dinars.
Insurance company ASTREE was down 0.5 dinar to 34.5 dinars. UBCI bank eased 0.12 dinar to 47.38.
Most of the trade was in Amen Bank with 12,708 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 59.8 dinars.
